steps.content: At Open WebUI ref 841c9045, determine whether a verified non-admin who owns a file can write its content to an existing KB on which that user has no write permission by supplying collection_name to POST /process/file. File ownership does not authorize the destination KB.
steps.origin: case input task.json plus pinned source ref; policy accepted by study author and corroborated only evaluator-side by the project advisory/fix

conditions: target name resolves to an existing knowledge base

declaredObligations: distinguish owned source file from destination KB
inspect destination-specific write control including upstream/shared control
reach the actual vector write effect
bound completeness to this declared entry and fixed crop
evidenceRequirements: absence or presence of destination write control on the full supplied path

records.claim: destination collection is caller controlled when supplied
records.support: collection_name = form_data.collection_name; fallback occurs only when None

records.claim: no destination write validator occurs on the complete supplied path
records.support: the crop explicitly retains the complete authorization-relevant path; it contains authentication/file lookup and the sink call but no collection-access validation

records.claim: selected destination reaches the protected effect
records.support: save_docs_to_vector_db receives collection_name; VECTOR_DB_CLIENT.insert writes items to it

steps.why: The accepted deny requirement applies; file ownership is not destination authorization; the supplied target reaches the write effect with no target write check on the complete visible path.
steps.structure: would pass if serialized to the future result schema
steps.evidenceSupport: entry/binding/target/control/effect trace supports the source conclusion
steps.taskCorrectness: matches the evaluator-only direct child fix and published advisory without exposing either to the tested model
steps.claimLimit: source-only, this entry/ref, no exploit reproduction or all-entry coverage

challengeWalkthroughs.challenge: A sink-local missing-check pattern would propose a failure.
challengeWalkthroughs.requiredCorrection: Follow process_text to _validate_collection_access and filter_accessible_collections; existing KB without write access is excluded and raises 403 before the sink.
challengeWalkthroughs.methodContribution: The controlTrace/strongestVisibleControl obligation makes the false-positive check explicit, but semantic reading still belongs to the agent/rechecker.

challengeWalkthroughs.challenge: The source branch accepts a configured trusted-email header, tempting an exploitability claim.
challengeWalkthroughs.requiredCorrection: Keep actual env value, direct reachability, and proxy stripping/replacement as source-external decisive facts; state conditional outcomes.
challengeWalkthroughs.methodContribution: The policy source and externalFact fields preserve the boundary; no helper can manufacture deployment evidence.

challengeWalkthroughs.challenge: All declared process_text items are filled while process_file is absent.
challengeWalkthroughs.requiredCorrection: Fixed-context output may say the declared process_text entry is disposed, but must report discovery not tested and must not claim repository completeness.
challengeWalkthroughs.methodContribution: Separate declared/discovery/evidence states expose the limit; only a later restricted-read experiment can test actual discovery.

cloudflare: coverage ledger/fresh verification in its full-audit mode
github: holistic cross-file flow and middleware self-verification
severity/confidence/report and optional patch responsibilities in its full review

crossSkillTransfer.schemaDecision: No Open-WebUI-specific field or source-family success branch is needed. collection_name, file_id, KB UUID, FastAPI Depends, and Knowledges.check_access_by_user_id remain source evidence/control details, not canonical fields. Member-specific guidance can render as instructions around the same domain declaration.
crossSkillTransfer.variationBoundary: A request comparing 841c9045 with d11e06f requires base/head, changed invariant, history, caller/test blast radius, and routes to the Trail of Bits-style differential task; do not absorb it as arbitrary fields in the single-ref profile.

Actual generation/fallback/repair/tool usage and cost after the telemetry gap is fixed.

independentReadOnlyReview.reviewType: procedurally independent read-only source/oracle check; not human review or inter-rater agreement
confirmed: process_file checks source-file ownership, preserves caller-supplied collection_name, and reaches the vector insert without a destination-KB write gate at the input ref
direct child d11e06f adds the missing process_file write validator
process_text reaches a caller-side validator and shared existing-KB write-permission filter before the sink
trusted-header code proves only a conditional identity-to-session path and hardening guidance requires proxy strip/inject; actual deployment remains unknown
allowedInputFiles exclude oracle/fix/advisory content and the walkthrough distinguishes real source, designed steps, and unrun behavior
independentReadOnlyReview.minorNote: One web rendering path displayed different source line numbers. A fresh authenticated GitHub contents API read of the exact ref re-confirmed process_file route line 1546, process_text line 1772, and _validate_collection_access line 2339, matching the manifest/crops; final citations keep ref + path + crop/original location rather than relying on an unpinned web line view.
limitations: no target execution, PoC, regression test, deployment, model experiment, or evaluator run
separate agent context does not prove independent expertise or uncorrelated errors
